tasks.statement_en: Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The number $2^{-1}\cdot 32^{\frac{3}{5}}$ equals: A. $-16$   B. $-4$   C. $2$   D. $4$

Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The number $\log_3\left(\dfrac32\right)+\log_3\left(\dfrac29\right)$ equals: A. $\log_3\dfrac{31}{18}$   B. $\log_3\dfrac{5}{11}$   C. $-1$   D. $\dfrac13$
Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The number $\left(2\sqrt{10}+\sqrt2\right)^2$ equals: A. $22$   B. $42$   C. $42+4\sqrt5$   D. $42+8\sqrt5$

Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The number of all positive integer solutions of the inequality $\dfrac{3x-5}{12}<\dfrac13$ equals: A. $2$   B. $3$   C. $5$   D. $6$

The polynomial $W(x)=ax^3+bx^2+cx+d$ is the product of the polynomials $F(x)=(2-3x)^2$ and $G(x)=3x-2$. Complete the sentence below. Write the appropriate number in the blank so that the sentence is true. The sum $a+b+c+d$ of the coefficients of the polynomial $W$ equals ..... .
Solve the equation $4x^3-12x^2-x+3=0$. Show your working.
Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The number $2$ is a zero of the linear function $f(x)=(3-m)x+4$. The number $m$ equals: A. $0$   B. $3$   C. $4$   D. $5$

The sequence $(a_n)$ is defined by $a_n=2\cdot(-1)^{n+1}+5$ for every natural number $n\ge1$. Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The sum of the first ten consecutive terms of this sequence equals: A. $3$   B. $7$   C. $50$   D. $100$

In the arithmetic sequence $(a_n)$, defined for every natural number $n\ge1$, the terms $a_1=7$ and $a_2=13$ are given. Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The term $a_{10}$ equals: A. $-47$   B. $52$   C. $61$   D. $67$

The bases of right trapezoid $ABCD$ have lengths $|AB|=8$ and $|CD|=5$. The altitude $AD$ of this trapezoid has length $\sqrt3$ (see figure). Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The measure of the acute angle $ABC$ equals: A. $15°$   B. $30°$   C. $45°$   D. $60°$ [Figure: right trapezoid ABCD, right angles at A and D, AB=8 the longer base, CD=5 the shorter base, AD=sqrt3 the height]

tasks.summary_pl: Łuk $AB$ to $\frac15$ okręgu. Oblicz kąt wpisany $ACB$
tasks.summary_en: Arc $AB$ is $\frac15$ of the circle. Find inscribed angle $ACB$
tasks.statement_en: Points $A$, $B$ and $C$ lie on a circle with centre $S$. The length of arc $AB$, on which the inscribed angle $ACB$ is subtended, equals $\dfrac15$ of the circumference of the circle (see figure). Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The measure of the acute angle $ACB$ equals: A. $18°$   B. $30°$   C. $36°$   D. $72°$ [Figure: circle with centre S and points A, B, C on it; inscribed angle ACB subtending arc AB]

The side of square $ABCD$ has length $12$. Point $S$ is the midpoint of side $BC$ of this square. Point $P$ lies on segment $AS$ so that segment $BP$ is perpendicular to segment $AS$. Compute the length of segment $BP$. Show your working.

In the Cartesian coordinate system $(x,y)$, points $A=(2,8)$ and $B=(10,2)$ are given. The perpendicular bisector of segment $AB$ intersects the $x$-axis of the coordinate system at point $P$. Compute the coordinates of point $P$ and the length of segment $AP$. Show your working.
tasks.notes: sum of the coordinates of P and |AP|: 9/4 + 0 + 5*sqrt(41)/4

tasks.summary_pl: Ostrosłup ma $2024$ ściany boczne. Ile ma krawędzi?
tasks.summary_en: Pyramid has $2024$ lateral faces. How many edges?
tasks.statement_en: A regular pyramid has $2024$ lateral faces. Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The total number of edges of this pyramid equals: A. $2025$   B. $2026$   C. $4048$   D. $4052$

tasks.summary_en: Face diagonal of a cube $=2\sqrt2$. Find the volume
tasks.statement_en: The diagonal of a face of a cube has length $2\sqrt2$. Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The volume of this cube equals: A. $8$   B. $24$   C. $\dfrac{16\sqrt6}{9}$   D. $16\sqrt2$

tasks.summary_en: Prism, base edge $4$, $\tan\alpha=2$. Find the height
tasks.statement_en: The base of a regular quadrilateral prism is a square with side length $4$. The diagonal of this prism is inclined to the plane of the base at an angle $\alpha$ such that $\tan\alpha=2$ (see figure). Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The height of this prism equals: A. $2$   B. $8$   C. $8\sqrt2$   D. $16\sqrt2$ [Figure: square prism, base edge 4, space diagonal making angle alpha with the base, tan alpha = 2]

tasks.summary_pl: Diagram ocen ze sprawdzianu. Oblicz średnią arytmetyczną
tasks.summary_en: Grade diagram from a test. Find the arithmetic mean
tasks.statement_en: The diagram shows the results of a mathematics test in a certain final-year class. The horizontal axis shows the grades obtained by the students, and the vertical axis shows the number of students who received a given grade. Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The arithmetic mean of the grades obtained from this test by the students of this class equals: A. $3$   B. $3.12$   C. $3.5$   D. $4.1(6)$ [Figure: bar chart, grades 1-6 on the horizontal axis, number of students on the vertical axis]

tasks.summary_pl: 4-cyfrowe parzyste z cyfr $2,4,7$. Ile ich jest?
tasks.summary_en: 4-digit even numbers from digits $2,4,7$. How many?
tasks.statement_en: Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The number of all four-digit even natural numbers, in whose decimal representation only the digits $2$, $4$, $7$ appear (e.g. $7272$, $2222$, $7244$), equals: A. $16$   B. $27$   C. $54$   D. $81$

A box contains only white and black balls. There are $18$ black balls. One ball is drawn at random from the box. The probability of the event that a black ball is drawn equals $\dfrac35$. Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The number of white balls in the box, before one ball was drawn, equals: A. $9$   B. $12$   C. $15$   D. $30$

tasks.summary_pl: Dwa rzuty kostką. Oblicz $P$(pierwszy wynik większy)
tasks.summary_en: Two dice rolls. Find $P$(first result greater)
tasks.statement_en: A random experiment consists of rolling a fair six-sided die twice, where the die has a different number of pips, from one to six, on each face. Compute the probability of event $A$ that the first roll shows a greater number of pips than the second roll. Show your working.

The owner of a toy shop conducted a local market survey on the effect of changing the price of a set of building blocks on the number of buyers. The survey shows that the daily revenue $P$ from selling sets of blocks, depending on the amount $x$ (in zł) by which the price is reduced, is given by $P(x)=(70-x)(20+x)$, where $x$ is an integer with $x\ge0$ and $x\le60$. Complete the table below: in each empty cell write the correct answer chosen from options A-E. 32.1. The daily revenue will be greatest when the number $x$ equals ..... . 32.2. The daily revenue will equal $800$ zł when the number $x$ equals ..... . A. $25$   B. $30$   C. $45$   D. $50$   E. $60$
